title: Community organization
description: A neighborhood-association site in a quiet newsletter register: gallery-white pages with tracked small-caps type, program spreads with documentary photography, a calendar that splits upcoming from past by itself with a computed next-up badge, annual membership dues as flat-rate tiers, a join form, and a board roster — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

theme.$comment: The atelier register's brand overlay: atelier carries no accent hue — its accent IS the ink (near-black in light mode, near-paper in dark), so CTAs render as quiet ink buttons. Setting brand to those same inks re-brands app surfaces into the register without shifting the marketing pages. Mode is light: atelier's native mode.

contentContract.$comment: The pack's content slots, as data (packs/README.md 'Content contract'). Declares what a composer (agent or tool) must bind for a generated variant of this pack to present as real: slot paths into the typed content module, their kinds, and minimums. events feeds the computed calendar (upcoming/past split, next-up badge) — its start slots are ISO local datetimes a composer must bind exactly, never prose. stats values are strings on purpose (shapes like "$24" and "1974" are typography, not arithmetic); membership tier prices are numbers because the pricing section renders them as dollar amounts. Authored alongside the module and guarded by the pack's content tests — the module satisfies the contract; the contract never drifts ahead of it.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed, merged over repobot.content.json at compose (the same overlay path as landing/theme — scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs applyPackOverlays). The events domain mirrors content.ts events entry for entry (the seed-fidelity tests pin it), minus the photographs — imagery stays code-owned and the pack joins it back by slug (View/Community/calendar.ts). Upcoming vs. past and the "Next up" highlight stay computed at render time by the events engine wherever the facts come from.

entries.title: Spring park cleanup
entries.description: Sixty neighbors, forty bags of winter, and the flower beds turned before lunch. The park stewards' biggest turnout yet.

entries.title: Garden season opening day
entries.description: Plot assignments, a compost delivery to shovel, and the first seedling swap of the year. Every bed claimed by noon.

entries.title: Porch concert: the Alder Street duo
entries.description: Guitar and upright bass from the porch steps, a hundred neighbors on the lawn, and the hat came back full — the summer's high-water mark.

entries.title: The Fernhill block party
entries.description: The fifty-second annual: long tables down the centerline, every household brings a dish, the association brings the permits and the string lights. Rain date the following Saturday.

entries.title: Porch concert: closing night
entries.description: The season's last sets before the weather calls it. Bring a chair and a jacket; the hat proceeds book next summer's musicians.

entries.title: Fall planting workday
entries.description: Twelve street trees and four hundred bulbs go in the ground before the frost. The city delivers the trees; we bring the shovels and the cider.

entries.title: General meeting: budget night
entries.description: The year's books line by line, next year's dues vote, and the floor open to any member with two minutes and an idea. Coffee's on at 6:30.

entries.title: Luminaria night
entries.description: Paper bags, sand, and a thousand candles down every sidewalk in the commons. Kits at the tool library the week before; lighting starts at dusk.

landing.$comment: Doc-aware pack pages: routes maps each pack route to the page id its config merges under (web/app/src/View/Community/CommunityPage.tsx, useSitePageConfig). pages seeds each page's layout skeleton — ids match communityLanding.ts; the platform's structural editor edits these. The preset is atelier (gallery-white walls, Inter tracked uppercase, hairline rules, zero radius, near-ink accent) — the newsletter register: photography carries all the warmth, type does the art direction, and every CTA is a quiet ink button.
